li.label: Filled by End Rod (Tight)
li.description: This violent piston movement is pure torture... My body is being torn apart... This pain makes me want to scream and howl...

li.label: Filled by End Rod (Adapted)
li.description: This constant feeling of swelling... is somehow not so unbearable anymore. My sanity is being eroded bit by bit by this feeling of a foreign object...

li.label: Filled by End Rod (Relaxed)
li.description: My inside is completely stretched open... As long as the piston keeps pushing, I can feel a twisted sense of relief...

li.label: Filled by End Rod (Broken)
li.description: Ah... my body has completely taken the shape of the End Rod. Just keep moving like this, let me be filled forever. This ecstasy... I can't stop...

li.label: Lack of Foreign Object (Empty)
li.description: That feeling of fullness is gone... Inside my body is now cold and hollow, I want to be filled again... Please let me go back...
